faq.title: Everything You Need to Know About the SaaS Platform
faq.sub: Clear technical and operational answers derived from our official user documentation.

items.q: How does the platform connect to our Microsoft Azure tenant?
items.a: The platform establishes a secure connection through Microsoft Entra ID (Service Principal) or multi-tenant delegation via Azure Lighthouse. An automated Azure CLI script grants strictly read-only built-in roles (Reader, Cost Management Reader, Monitoring Reader, and Billing Reader), ensuring no infrastructure can be altered without explicit permission.

items.q: What permissions are required for active remediation features?
items.a: For Business and Enterprise tiers that leverage active remediation, a custom least-privilege role (CSCloudSolutions Remediation Role) is configured to permit only designated tasks: starting/stopping VMs, deleting audited zombie resources, and writing tags. All destructive actions can require a pre-deletion backup snapshot and mandatory four-eyes approval.

items.q: How does CSCloud FinOps compare to native Azure Cost Management?
items.a: Azure Cost Management is a passive reporting dashboard that explains what was spent in the past. CSCloud FinOps translates metrics into execution: it pinpoints exact remediation actions, audits 25+ zombie resource types with instant delete actions, validates Terraform plans before merging, models Savings Plans with ESR, and provides FinOps Copilot for conversational root-cause analysis.

items.q: Can we test the platform without connecting our live Azure environment?
items.a: Yes. Through a guided demonstration session with our certified specialists, you can explore every capability of the platform operating on a controlled environment with simulated data and preconfigured profiles, without risking or connecting your production infrastructure. Demo access is provided exclusively through prior scheduling via our contact form.

items.q: What is the FOCUS 1.1 standard and why does it matter?
items.a: FOCUS (FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification) is the global open standard governed by the FinOps Foundation to standardize cloud cost nomenclature and datasets. CSCloud FinOps features native FOCUS 1.1 export capabilities, empowering organizations to export clean, normalized cost data directly into executive Power BI templates without vendor lock-in.

items.q: How long does onboarding and initial data ingestion take?
items.a: Initial tenant onboarding takes under 10 minutes. Once authenticated with Microsoft Entra ID and the least-privilege script is executed, the initial billing synchronization finishes in roughly 60 seconds, immediately revealing the executive WhiteBoard and high-priority savings opportunities.

refundPolicy.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
refundPolicy.intro: This Refund and Cancellation Policy governs purchases made through CSCloudSolutions (cscloudsolutions.com.ar) and our cloud financial management platform CSCloud FinOps (finops.cscloudsolutions.com.ar).
refundPolicy.saasContent1: Our software as a service (SaaS) is offered with a monthly or annual billing structure. To ensure our platform fits your needs, we offer a 14-day free trial on our Professional and Business plans.
refundPolicy.saasTrial: During the trial period: You can cancel your subscription at any time before the 14 days end without any charge to your credit card.
refundPolicy.saasAfter: After the trial period: Due to the nature of digital products and the free evaluation period provided, we do not offer refunds once the subscription charge has been processed (whether monthly or annually).
refundPolicy.saasCancel: Cancellations: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account administration panel. Cancellation will stop future charges, and you will retain access to the platform until the end of your current billing cycle.
refundPolicy.consultingContent1: For consulting services, migrations to Azure, Microsoft 365, custom FinOps audits, or Azure Virtual Desktop implementations, refunds are governed by the Service Level Agreement (SLA) or Statement of Work (SOW) signed by both parties.
refundPolicy.consultingContent2: Consulting hours already executed, technical diagnoses performed, and cloud resources deployed in the client's tenant are non-refundable.
refundPolicy.consultingContent3: If a project is canceled before completion, only the work completed up to the date of written notification will be billed.
refundPolicy.paymentsContent: Our subscription payments are securely processed through our authorized partners (Merchant of Record). By making a purchase, you also agree to the terms and conditions of our payment processor. Any billing dispute should first be communicated to our team to attempt an amicable resolution.
refundPolicy.exceptionsContent: We may make exceptions to this policy at our sole discretion if we consider that there has been a technical error on our part that prevented full use of the platform for an extended period.
refundPolicy.contactContent: If you have any questions about your billing, wish to cancel your account, or believe there has been an error in your charge, please contact us by writing to:
